flags.message: The September 17 snapshot records both August 24 opposition briefs and the September 14 reply, but the provisioned document manifest contains only petition/QP text fetched July 18. Recovered selected text from all three missing briefs using their exact official PDF URLs in the snapshot. Forecast is not opposition-blind; no provisioned input was modified.

Both pre-decision opposition briefs report denial of certiorari in the separate controlling Curtis litigation; Shriners dates it June 1, 2026. This legitimate pre-baseline related-case signal materially reduced the grant estimate. No outcome of this Roberts petition was sought or encountered, and no related-case subsequent-history search was performed.
